exposure: Implementation of a standardized intrapartum gentamicin computerized provider order entry and dosage form dispensing system
outcome: Time from gentamicin ordering to administration
Maternal and neonatal clinical outcomes (complications of chorioamnionitis)
cohort: The study included hospitalized obstetric patients with chorioamnionitis.
finding: The implemented system changes improved the efficiency of gentamicin administration by reducing the time from ordering to administration, but they did not alter clinical outcomes for patients with chorioamnionitis.
